body: Orphaned 19-bot leftover pool (PPID reparented to 1, stale since 05:55) doubled with the supervised 19-bot pool from 10:10 -> 38 bots against a 20-slot lobby, bots alone filled every match so the human's queue slot never landed and match_phase never reached ARENA_PHASE_DRAFT. Killed the orphaned PIDs live, added a pkill guard to scripts/run_bot_pool.sh to prevent recurrence.
title: fix: stale bot-pool double-booking blocked human draft entry
